name: Nerest Client
changelog: Added a safety pause for CustomSky on D3D Feature Level 10.x after repeated NVIDIA driver crashes. A chat message explains when it activates.
Fixed generated build-stamp dependencies so crash reports identify the actual build.
Stabilized CustomSky shader creation on Feature Level 10.0 and 10.1 by using the Shader Model 4.0 path after the NVIDIA driver crash report.
Fixed CustomSky to replace the sky in the world render pass instead of drawing an overlay over the finished frame.
Fixed CustomSky initialization: added full support for D3D Feature Level 10_0 and 10_1 with automatic shader target fallback (vs_4_0/ps_4_0)
Added Direct3D Feature Level display in real-time chat diagnostics
Fixed CustomSky camera projection, FOV radian conversion, and full 360-degree sky dome coverage
Fixed CustomSky color palette loading on style change (Aurora, Nebula, Galaxy) and blend states
Added Custom Colors and Full Opaque settings to CustomSky module
Fixed player entity visibility across all servers and entity archetypes
Launcher Mojang intro overlay countdown transition reduced to 5s
Cat companion enlarged by 50% and perfectly positioned on GUI edge
Added Auto Crit in Aura module (Baritone jump mechanics)
Added Snow particles in Social GUI background
